name: returnshield
description: ReturnShield marketplace trust and returns system (synthetic demo build).

scripts.typecheck: npm run sync:schemas && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:unit: npm run sync:schemas && npm run test:unit --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:contract: npm run sync:schemas && npm run test:contract --workspace packages/contracts
scripts.build: npm run sync:schemas && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.seed:load: npm run build --workspace packages/contracts && npm run seed --workspace @returnshield/seed-tools -- load
scripts.seed:verify: npm run build --workspace packages/contracts && npm run seed --workspace @returnshield/seed-tools -- verify
scripts.seed:reset: npm run build --workspace packages/contracts && npm run seed --workspace @returnshield/seed-tools -- reset
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run check:schemas && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run test:contract && npm run build && npm run synth
